# Synthetic GNATdoc conformance fixture

All GNATdoc output, page hashes and anchors in this fixture are SYNTHETIC,
generated by scripts/make_synthetic_fixtures.py to reproduce the observed
GNATdoc 26 HTML structure. They are not snapshots of a real GNATdoc run.
Package names and selected APIs reflect the source repositories reviewed
at the pinned SHAs in docs/source-implementation-matrix.md; simplified
declarations are not authoritative source or ABI contracts.
Full consumer-site qualification remains a separate adoption gate.
